answer: I’m not aware of any special replication‑lag guarantee beyond the normal WAL streaming replication. In practice, pgvector’s HNSW index updates are written to WAL and are replicated to a streaming replica exactly like any other transaction, so the lag is the same as the underlying streaming‑replication delay – i.e. effectively zero additional lag.
